def sieve(limit):
    primes = []
    is_prime = [True] * (limit + 1)
    is_prime[0] = is_prime[1] = False
    for p in range(2, limit + 1):
        if is_prime[p]:
            primes.append(p)
            for multiple in range(p * p, limit + 1, p):

    return primes

    for p_tuple in itertools.combinations(primes, k):
        m = math.prod(p_tuple)
        good_numbers.add(m)

# Sort and print the first 20
